originality.rationale: Edmonds supplies the H-description but not the Euclidean distances and global rank-orbit minimizer. Aprile et al address extension complexity and facet slacks; Dong/Ge count trees with specified forests. A previously published biclique in-in zonotope inball theorem was read completely but defines an ambient vertex-space Minkowski sum, not this edge-indicator graphic base polytope; no isometric implication. Exact Euclidean inball and all center-locus phase dimensions remain independently meaningful absent a located stronger same-body metric theorem. Historical matroid-Chebyshev literature risk explicit.

value.rationale: Exact intrinsic Euclidean inball geometry and all incenter dimensions are natural structural invariants of a canonical infinite family of graphic matroid base polytopes. The proof screens all exponentially many rank inequalities, identifies just coordinate and degree facets, exceptional low graphs and a sharp p^(3/2) phase; center dimensions can jump from zero to order pq. This is not a mere arithmetic table or a standard inequality restatement.
